Name: herdr agent status
Author: cdcxd
Description: Live herdr agent status on your Stream Deck: red when an agent needs you, blue while it works.

Actions.Name: Agent
Actions.Tooltip: Shows one herdr agent's status. Press to focus it.

Actions.Name: Summary
Actions.Tooltip: Counts agents by status. Press to focus the one that needs you.

Actions.Name: Usage (Claude)
Actions.Tooltip: Claude plan usage. Press to switch between the 5-hour and weekly window.
